title: Which path sets the pace?
description: A constant-delay, max-plus timing model with one input splitting and reconverging. Delays are in nanoseconds; input arrival is zero. This teaching model omits logic sensitization, interconnect, slew, load, clocks and setup/hold checks; it is not full static timing signoff.

cues.title: Two routes, one source
cues.intent: Read the different branch delays from a shared input arrival of zero.

narration.en: One input splits into two paths: two nanoseconds above, five below. Both paths reach the same final gate.
narration.zh: 一个输入分成两条路径：上方延迟两纳秒，下方五纳秒。两条路径汇入同一个末级逻辑门。

captions.en: One input splits into two paths: two nanoseconds above, five below. Both paths reach the same final gate.
captions.zh: 一个输入分成两条路径：上方延迟两纳秒，下方五纳秒。两条路径汇入同一个末级逻辑门。

cues.title: The later input sets arrival
cues.intent: Compute output arrival as maximum input arrival plus the final gate delay.

narration.en: Its output arrival time is the later input arrival, plus its own delay. Five plus one gives six nanoseconds.
narration.zh: 输出到达时间，等于较晚的输入到达时间，加上末级门自身的延迟。五加一，得到六纳秒。

captions.en: Its output arrival time is the later input arrival, plus its own delay. Five plus one gives six nanoseconds.
captions.zh: 输出到达时间，等于较晚的输入到达时间，加上末级门自身的延迟。五加一，得到六纳秒。

cues.title: A different path becomes critical
cues.intent: Observe the critical branch switch at equal delays, then manipulate the same model.

narration.en: Increase the upper delay past five. The critical path changes. Now try controlling these delays yourself.
narration.zh: 把上方延迟增加到五纳秒以上，关键路径就会改变。现在，试着自己调整这些延迟。

captions.en: Increase the upper delay past five. The critical path changes. Now try controlling these delays yourself.
captions.zh: 把上方延迟增加到五纳秒以上，关键路径就会改变。现在，试着自己调整这些延迟。

exercises.prompt: Make the upper path uniquely critical while keeping output arrival at or below 6 ns. Many delay combinations work.

provenance.note: Original authored DAG and SVG, using the elementary max-plus arrival recurrence. No upstream course code or third-party artwork is included. Independent expected arithmetic is in check.mjs.
